in_marathi.name: Akshath
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Eye mark, sign
in_marathi.long_meaning: Akshath हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Akshatha refers to the divine mark or sign, often used for protection and blessings. The name Akshath is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘aksh’ (eye) and ‘ath’ (sign or mark).
